Our engineering team has identified the issue affecting our API and is actively working toward a full resolution. Performance has been restored, and we’re continuing to closely monitor the situation and make adjustments as needed.

Thank you for your patience and understanding while we work to ensure everything is running smoothly.

We are currently addressing an issue affecting services utilizing our API. 

Our teams are working to identify the cause and restore affected services as quickly as possible.

Customers may have issues running commands utilizing the API. This currently disrupts provisioning of servers over the API.

We are investigating an issue affecting new deployments in our Tokyo (NRT) region. Our engineering team has identified the affected network segment and is actively working to resolve it. Existing services and previously deployed instances are not impacted and continue to function normally. We will provide updates as more information becomes available.

We are currently addressing an anomaly affecting provisioning in our Tokyo location. Our System Administrators are working with onsite technicians to identify the cause and restore affected services as quickly as possible.

Event Type: Network Upgrade

We are performing system changes in the Chicago location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-09-10 05:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-09-10 08:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to maintain our ideal hosting environment. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact; however, Chicago instances may be unreachable for some, or all, of the scheduled maintenance window as we perform network, firmware, or host upgrades.
